findingSource: CodeRabbit PR #4 summary, updated 2026-10-06T00:18:52Z: unrelated publications can reset Following/profile pagination
before: Five cases reproduced resets from unrelated publication changes in Profile/Following and post-snapshot publications in Everyone/Profile/Following.
after: All five pass. Protection cases retain relevant update/withdrawal invalidation across all three scopes and mid-read withdrawal detection; both legacy cursor versions request refresh. Migration tests retain existing journal, possession and binding rows.
compatibility: Publication writes still increment the original global counter. New readers subtract the publication clock and compare per-generation revision marks against journal IDs in scope and within publicMax. Withdrawal marks survive binding deletion; re-publication creates a new event.
limitations: Time projection/reorg/follow invalidation remains conservative; this change scopes publication invalidation.
